label: CONCRETE_IN_A2P1_2: capable of causing…: A2P1 defines concrete by capability to be a cause OR to be…
term: concrete in A2P1: capable of causing or being caused
definition: A2P1 defines concrete by capability to be a cause OR to be caused. The selected negative answer denies necessary universal coverage of that broader domain by a chain both without a first member and without even partial outside causes. Capability is not actual exercise, ordinary physicality, or membership in an Ontic actual-node subtype.
note: Pinned A2P1 term@title. A2c instead uses capability to cause alone. Denial of universal coverage over a broader domain does not by logic entail denial over its narrower subdomain; the source-to-conclusion correspondence remains open. OPEN declaration-completion blocker (2026-11-09): first settle whether capability is accessible-world exercise, unexercised disposition, or both as explicit interpretations, with world, endpoint-existence and individual identity scope. Then the broader domain must retain BOTH outgoing and incoming capability for the same interpretation. Existential wrapping of a primitive CanCause is only a conditional control, not completion of this original. SurveyCapabilityControls demonstrates inclusion, an incoming-only separator, and failure of broad-denial-to-narrow-denial transfer; it proves no source chain or modal coverage assertion.
